How it works in Salt Lake City

From walkthrough to working robot.

One partner runs the whole job for your Salt Lake City operation — you approve the plan, we handle the rest and keep it running.

1
We walk your site

A free site assessment — floor plan, surfaces, obstacles, and the labor you want to hand off. No throughput promises before we see the floor.

2
We match the unit

We shortlist the 2–3 chosen-manufacturer robots that fit the work — matched to the floor, not the brochure — and confirm the model with you.

3
You pick the terms

Buy it, finance it, or rent it monthly. Your CFO picks the structure; we surface the options up front, with no single-price trap.

4
We deploy & integrate

We install on your floor, map the space, and connect the robot to the systems you already run — a working machine, not a project.

5
We train your team

Your staff learn the daily handling in an afternoon. Routines, scheduling, and dashboards are set up before we leave.

6
We keep it running

10-minute remote triage in business hours, 24-hour on-site dispatch, and a backup unit on hand. One in three issues never needs a truck.

One partner for the whole deployment in Salt Lake City

A robot in Salt Lake City should be a working machine, not a project you manage. We select the unit, finance it, deploy and map your floor, connect it to the systems you already run, train your team, and keep it serviced.

Service area · Salt Lake City, UT

We deploy and service commercial robots across Salt Lake City and the surrounding Utah metro.

Why Salt Lake City operations put robots on the floor.

Scrubbing floors, running trays, and watching a lot at 2am are the shifts Salt Lake City operators struggle to fill. Robots take the repetitive jobs so your people cover the work that needs a person.

A robot runs the same route, logs every run, and doesn't call out — a measurable, repeatable result instead of a variable one. We size the labor you hand off before you sign, so the return is grounded in your floor. See the payback-period breakdown and pricing options.
